description: THIS IS A FIRM FIXED-PRICE SUPPLY TYPE CONTRACT NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound, in support of Military Sealift Command, is negotiating a SOLE SOURCE requirement for the procurement of OEM Pacific Maritime Industries Corp., Storage Locker Replacement.  See solicitation for requirements. Closes on 04 March 2026 at 10:00 AM EST. All questions regarding this solicitation should be submitted to Aquaseia Osman via email at aquaseia.t.osman.civ@us.navy.mil.
